items.claim: Keep a stackless original error in the no-stack test. The test `creates new stack if original error has no stack` now builds its original with `new Error('original')`, which always has a `stack`, so the constructor takes the `originalError.stack` branch instead of the fallback the test is named for.
items.consequence: At the base, this was the only test covering an `originalError` without a stack. A regression in that branch, for example dropping the `.stack` check, now passes the head test but fails the base test.
items.proposed_fix: Give the test an original error that really has no stack and still passes Flow strict, for example `const original: any = { message: 'original' };`. The same commit already uses `: any` this way in `locatedError-test.js`.

items.claim: Only the `declare class` constructor gained `| null` for `nodes`, while the implementing `function GraphQLError` signature still reads `$ReadOnlyArray<ASTNode> | ASTNode | void` and its body already treats `null` like `undefined`.
